transcript.text: Hi everyone! So, as you all know, we're doing the Sunday brunch at Oak Street community hall to celebrate Aunt June's retirement. Guests will be eating around 12:30, and we've got the kitchen, folding tables, and room for about twenty-five people. Before I finalize the food and serving plan, I want to go around and hear from each of you — anything I should know that might shape the final plan? Dietary needs, timing concerns, serving ideas, whatever you've got. Let's hear it!
